metadata.description: Kaizen Analytix's internal plugins, skills and MCP connectors for Claude Code and Cowork, organized by company vertical.

plugins.name: kaizen-pdp-foundation
plugins.description: Shared foundation for every PDP plugin: scaffolds the standard project folder structure and checklists in SharePoint/OneDrive, enforces file conventions, and defines the guardrails.

plugins.name: kaizen-sales-handoff
plugins.description: Sales-to-delivery handoff: KT brief, kickoff deck and project plan, initial backlog (pushed to Jira), and the RAID log and RACI chart.

plugins.name: kaizen-solution-design
plugins.description: Analyze & Design phase: business requirements, technical design docs, data models, solution-overview, data-flow, API-sequence and architecture diagrams, plus a build handoff package.

plugins.name: kaizen-project-governance
plugins.description: Status reports built from the project plan and live Jira progress, feeding the project governance scorecard.

plugins.name: kaizen-project-delivery
plugins.description: Build phase: sprint and monthly review summaries generated straight from Jira.

plugins.name: kaizen-project-closeout
plugins.description: Project wrap-up: support plan handoff, client sign-off, case study, lessons learned, and project archive.

plugins.name: architecture-foundations
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic architecture principles (clean-architecture zones, state, test pyramid), the greenfield kickoff orchestrator, and the adopt-vs-defer decision for existing codebases. Ships SessionStart and PreToolUse hooks.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: The authority layer for technical delivery: previews before destructive or database-writing commands (Bash and PowerShell), a hard scope gate on database file edits only, and a standing block on git commit/push/PR — the agent drafts commit messages and PR descriptions as text, with no AI attribution. Ships SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse and PostToolUse hooks.

plugins.name: codebase-map
plugins.description: Per-machine cache of codebase structure facts, refreshed on a git-SHA checkpoint, so skills can orient without re-reading the repo every session.

plugins.name: design-system
plugins.description: Visual foundation defined before the first component: typography scale, design tokens, responsive breakpoints, and a Tailwind @theme adapter.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Domain-modular React apps (Vite, React Router, RTK Query, shadcn/ui, Vitest), with thin architecture adapters for Vue and Angular.

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: Clean-architecture FastAPI backends with testing, bootstrap and best practices, plus thin adapters for Node.js, NestJS, Django and Spring.

plugins.name: api-contract
plugins.description: One OpenAPI schema as the source of truth, generating typed DTOs for frontend and backend so they never drift.

plugins.name: e2e-testing
plugins.description: Cross-stack Playwright tests that verify UI action, API request, business logic and database state as one chain, with human-in-the-loop scoping.

plugins.name: deployment
plugins.description: Chooses how an app should ship before writing anything: Dockerfiles, CI/CD pipelines, dev/staging/prod config, secrets, and rollback.

plugins.name: kaizen-data-science
plugins.description: Data science on demand: exploration and quality checks, statistical analysis, modeling (predictive, forecasting, Bayesian, optimization), matplotlib/seaborn charts, and export to a reproducible Jupyter notebook in the Kaizen project structure.

plugins.name: kvantum-data-prep
plugins.description: Kvantum Element X pre-load prep: raw client extracts plus template in, validated load-ready file and an input-review dashboard out.

plugins.name: general-productivity-skills
plugins.description: Everyday Kaizen skills: branded PowerPoint decks from the Kaizen 2026 template, and daily/weekly meeting briefs with a rolling action tracker from Teams transcripts.
